## R

All the R packages of the dengueverse are built on [R-universe](https://fdzul.r-universe.dev), which provides binaries for Windows, macOS and Linux. Add the universe to your repositories and install as usual:

``` r
options(repos = c(fdzul = "https://fdzul.r-universe.dev",
                  CRAN  = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

install.packages(c("rgeomex", "densnv", "denhotspots"))
```

deneggs needs [INLA](https://www.r-inla.org), which is not on CRAN:

``` r
install.packages("INLA",
                 repos = c(getOption("repos"),
                           INLA = "https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"),
                 dep = TRUE)
install.packages("deneggs")
```

The development versions can also be installed from GitHub:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("fdzul/densnv")
```

## Python

The Python packages are installed from GitHub with pip (Python 3.10 or later):

``` bash
pip install "git+https://github.com/fdzul/rgeomex-py"
pip install "git+https://github.com/fdzul/denguedatasets-py"
pip install "git+https://github.com/fdzul/dengueriskcdmx-py"
```

rgeomex-py downloads the polygons on demand and keeps them in a local cache, so the installation is small.
